sketch_notes: Both sketches depict a largely static article/detail page with branding at the top, long-form text content, and footer social icons. No explicit or strongly implied JavaScript-driven widgets are visible in either viewport: there is no hamburger icon, submenu indicator, search field, form, tabs, accordion, modal trigger, sticky treatment, load-more control, or infinite-scroll cue. The footer icons and header links imply ordinary navigation only, which does not require JavaScript by this taxonomy. Any richer behavior such as comments loading, analytics, or responsive nav would be implementation-dependent rather than sketch-implied.
